crossRefs.note: She weeps bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her. All…
Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
“He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
“But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your…
All your lovers have forgotten you. They don’t seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the…
“Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: “Behold…
All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. “Look…
“Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held…
Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing…
Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
Therefore Yahweh says concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, but I didn’t send them, yet they say, ‘Sword and…
for both prophet and priest are profane. Yes, in my house I have found their wickedness,” says Yahweh.
Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahweh has spoken…

translations.web: “I called for my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls.
translations.bsb: I called out to my lovers, but they have betrayed me. My priests and elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
translations.kjv: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
translations.asv: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: My priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, While they sought them food to refresh their souls.
